Preserve target head/hair/crown position, torso lean, costume, both arms and shoulder-sleeve-elbow-hand links, sword in RIGHT near hand, blue talisman in LEFT far hand. Feet long axes straight EAST screen RIGHT, no outward splay, no V feet. Anatomical far LEFT leg is support this half, anatomical near RIGHT leg swings lifted in foreground. Boot sole contact implied at roughly95% canvas height, no drawn floor/shadow. Do not translate/resize whole figure; independent native leg drawing, no image duplication, mirror, interpolation, warp, collage or text.
Far LEFT support boot fully flat, directly below/slightly forward of pelvis projection around 61% canvas width. Left knee bent softly absorbing weight. Near RIGHT knee has moved just forward across left support knee in foreground but RIGHT boot remains bent/lifted about half boot-height above floor. This is second body-approaches-left-support pose; do NOT retain current far-behind toe-off boot.
